info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Windows Background Tasks Accelerometer Credentials API
Microsoft Windows 10 Create a Windows Hello key credential

items.docs: Creates a new key credential for Windows Hello authentication using KeyCredentialManager.RequestCreateAsync. Generates a public/private key pair where the private key is stored securely on the device (in TPM if available) and the public key is returned for server registration.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Open an existing key credential

params.name: accountId
params.description: The account identifier for the credential

items.docs: Opens an existing Windows Hello key credential using KeyCredentialManager.OpenAsync. Returns the credential if it exists, allowing the application to use it for signing operations.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Delete a key credential

params.name: accountId
params.description: The account identifier for the credential

items.docs: Deletes a Windows Hello key credential using KeyCredentialManager.DeleteAsync. Removes the key pair from the device.
